core_obligations: Prove the base case d = 0: identify the stalks of R^qf_!M with H^q_c of the geometric fibre by lemma-stalk-R-f-shriek and conclude they are finite Lambda-modules by lemma-finiteness-curves (proof lines 4741-4746).

Set up the induction step: reduce to finding a dense open U with constructible restriction, using base change compatibility of Rf_!M for the complement and the generic-point neighbourhood formulation (proof lines 4749-4758).

Carry out the reduction chain over a generic point: choose the good-curves diagram; descend constructibility from the finite surjective V -> U by the etale-cohomology check-constructible lemma and base change; take the part (4) open W, note the complement Z has 0-dimensional fibres hence quasi-finite, and use the relative triangle plus the quasi-finite constructibility lemma to reduce to R(W -> V)_!M; transport across the thickening nu; discard Z' by a second triangle; decompose over the normalisation pieces by lemma-shriek-composition and conclude with lemma-proper-smooth-family-curves-modules since T_i -> V is finite etale (proof lines 4761-4825).
proof_roadmap: Base case via compact cohomology of the fibres (proof lines 4738-4746).
Induction setup: dense open and generic-point reduction (proof lines 4749-4758).
Good-curves reduction chain down to the proper smooth family case (proof lines 4761-4825).
